item.title: Did Russia comply with rules in reporting lab worker's death?
item.description: A global treaty signed by 197 countries, including Russia, mandates reporting any death that could indicate an outbreak.

item.title: U.S. seeks to reverse Egyptian man's deportation to Africa
item.description: The Trump administration is working to return Ahmed Soliman to the U.S. after an Arizona judge ruled his deportation violated due process.

item.title: Oil industry prepares for Hurricane Isaias
item.description: Hurricane Isaias, the season's first Atlantic hurricane, is headed toward the northern Gulf Coast. The oil industry is making preparations.
